title: Identifying and Mitigating Social Bias Knowledge in Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model propensity to choose stereotypical associations using fill-in-the-blank tasks (StereoSet), counterfactual minimal sentence pairs (CrowS-Pairs), word set associations (WEAT), and pronoun-occupation coreference tests (WinoBias, Winogender, BEC-Pro). The paper also tests factual knowledge retention and generalization using the proposed BiaScope benchmark.

Measuring stereotypical vs. anti-stereotypical associations using fill-in-the-blank challenges (StereoSet), masked token probabilities in counterfactual sentence pairs (CrowS-Pairs), word set associations (WEAT), and evaluating commonsense knowledge retention and paraphrase generalization (BiaScope).

Assessing stereotype adherence through fill-in-the-blank tasks (StereoSet), probability assessments of masked tokens in intrasentential minimal pairs (CrowS-Pairs), word set associations (WEAT), and evaluating factual retention and generalization metrics via the proposed BiaScope benchmark.
